- Finish the existing “99 Nights” project as a complete, playable mobile browser survival game set in a low-poly dark forest.
- The user asked to continue prior work, but the repository had no game implementation; the previous build attempt had failed.

## Requirements
- Build a complete playable game now; do not ask clarifying questions.
- Support mobile touch controls: left joystick to move and right-side dragging to look.
- Include a dark, foggy forest and a central campfire.
- Save checks as small JPEGs at viewport width no more than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented the game with Three.js and Vite as a static browser app.
- Chose survival mechanics: enemies pursue the player, health recovers near the fire, nights progress every 18 seconds, and surviving through Night 99 wins.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `package.json`, `index.html`, `src/style.css`, and `src/main.js` with the Three.js survival game, responsive HUD, start/game-over/victory overlays, touch controls, forest environment, campfire, enemies, health, and night progression.
- Installed dependencies and verified `npm run build` succeeds.
- Started Vite dev server on port 3000.
- Captured and read the latest browser screenshot at `/tmp/99nights-check2.jpg` (1050×793 JPEG).

### Active
- Finish validating gameplay and touch controls in-browser; consider whether remaining polish or bugs need fixing.
- Review `git status` and summarize the final build and checks.

### Blocked
- Browser console has a 404 for `/favicon.ico`; WebGL performance warnings appeared during screenshot capture, but the page rendered.
- The screenshot-reading tool confirmed the image loaded, but no visual details were reported in text.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `/tmp/99nights-check2.jpg` visually and test starting/moving/looking in the browser.
2. Fix any discovered issues and rerun `npm run build`.
3. Check `git status` and report implementation, test results, and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Three.js scene and gameplay mechanics.
- `src/style.css`: Responsive visual design and touch-control layout.
- `index.html`: Game canvas, HUD, overlays, and module entry.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- `npm install` completed with 2 reported vulnerabilities (one moderate, one high).
- `npm run build` succeeded after the game changes.
- Dev server was launched with `npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000`; it may still be running.
- No changes were committed.
